summary: Priority desk assembly and access onboarding for EU hybrid hire - desk E3-42
description: Issue summary: New senior ML engineer (Evelyn Sørensen) starts onsite 2026-03-15. Need priority desk assembly and temporary badge access to building and secure floor. Impact: Onboarding delay if desk, monitors, and badge not ready — first-week meetings scheduled with product and infra. Location: Office B, Floor 3, desk E3-42. Requested deadline: 2026-03-14 COB. Assets to prepare/ship: 2x 27" monitors (Dell U2722D), 1x CalDigit TS4 dock, 1x keyboard + mouse, 1x laptop riser and cables, 1x spare power strip, 1x KVM adapter (shared), Monitor arms to be assembled. Shipping/Allocation notes: Use local office stock for monitors and arms; dock and keyboard to be pulled from hardware pool. If unavailable, expedite courier pickup from central IT stock (warehouse WH-EU-02). Shipping carrier preferred: DPD express; alternate: DHL Express. Badge/access details: Temporary badge for building main entrance and Floor 3 server room corridor; badge to be time-limited (valid 2026-03-15 to 2026-04-15) pending full HR onboarding. Assign badge provisioning to Access Control team (security.ticket@redwood.ai) and Slack notify #facilities. Networking: Pre-configure Wi-Fi SSO and VLAN tagging for desk; add MAC address placeholder until laptop is assigned. Acceptance criteria: 1) Desk E3-42 physically staged, monitors mounted, cables labeled; 2) Badge issued and tested to open main door and Floor 3 by 09:00 2026-03-15; 3) IT confirms CalDigit dock tested with a loaner laptop; 4) All assets recorded with asset tags and images uploaded to Confluence page. Steps taken so far: - 2026-03-10: Request submitted to facilities stock check - 2026-03-10: IT reserved CalDigit TS4 from WH-EU-02 - 2026-03-11: Security pre-approval email from Marcel (building security) - 2026-03-11: Slack ping in #facilities and #it-support. Next actions: Facilities to schedule desk assembly window; ShipOps to arrange courier if local stock short; Access Control to create temporary badge and arrange desk test on 2026-03-14. Notes: Employee prefers dual-monitor setup and sits near team (row E). Please update ticket with tracking numbers or badge ID once available.
